notes.title: Patch! 2k & 4k resolutions, throw mechanic improvements, running speed increased
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, dear Single Valley resident![/h3]

[b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/e03642743fa587e04093ef54fc749e3330c4b62e.png[/img] The patch has been delivered right to your doorstep![/b]

[h3][b]- GAMEPLAY -[/b][/h3]
- Redesign of the throw mechanic for controller; aim with Analogue stick and press Trigger to throw in a certain direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/7ff4ebaafd6a1ae84ad9194ec5ca7658e3e61002.gif[/img]
- ⬆️ Subtle throw directional line added to show where you are aiming for mouse and controller.
- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/dbd8afa36afc3cebe584281c89368b8e4bb8bc2e.gif[/img]Jack's running speed with all [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/699f824e8a5461610640061f1f291da39e2c95f9.png[/img] shoes increased. 
- Dynamic Friction increased to make Jack slide less.
- Double-tap roll removed as it was causing accidental rollings.
- If [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/59819d765cbaa88e9a1ed9676abd93c286cf2105.png[/img]a jar of hooch or poison is used, you get [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/02d16c179c481166c7bae58c63a54ea97ecddc6f.png[/img]an empty jar back.
- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/7e177ce5d8edaf42d253fc61baca834964ea0565.png[/img] Balloon clones now have shadows.
- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/7e177ce5d8edaf42d253fc61baca834964ea0565.png[/img] Balloon clones can be freed by jumping at or through them.
- [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/7e177ce5d8edaf42d253fc61baca834964ea0565.png[/img] Tree clones can be freed using interact and if hit by thrown items.
- Added more [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/15b6950863daa3e888ae23572d3ab207ac179432.png[/img] trash can lids to the latter half of the game.
- Reduced the chase scene difficulty a little again.
- Elevators in Gorge Cliffs were given consistent speed.
- Exploding rocks no longer insta-kill if you have [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/15b6950863daa3e888ae23572d3ab207ac179432.png[/img] a trash can lid.
- Made Robotronputer a bit easier to access.

[h3][b]- BUG FIXES -[/b][/h3]
- Change to picking up [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/699f824e8a5461610640061f1f291da39e2c95f9.png[/img] shoes. Picking up lower level shoes will not replace higher level shoes.
- More safety measures added to prevent the "disappearing Marilyn" issue.
- Extra safety measure: Marilyn will appear in Art Galley if you happen to lose her when following her.
- Trader giving two of each items bought instead of one fixed… sorry!
- Elevators in Gorge Cliffs puzzle logic fix.
- Vine hint no longer stops a vine grab from occurring on first try.

[h3][b]- UI -[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/647f4cb29b080e39cb9bf0f0299bb47f790ba340.gif[/img]
🖥️ [b]2k and 4k resolutions added[/b]

[h3][b]- DIALOGUE -[/b][/h3]
- Fix for Pops being referred to as Baby Bro in the equipment inventory. It was not a meta story twist.
- Double tap roll tutorial tip removed.

notes.title: 1 day before release! | New mechanics breakdown
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, dear residents![/h1]

We're super excited for the release of [b][i]Mayhem in Single Valley[/i][/b], which is coming out tomorrow! Whew, what a ride it's been! Anyway, while you're waiting, we decided to tell you more about the most recent gameplay mechanics that we've added to the game.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/575809a5e32f2e4f9daba5a9a359ddae3daf6fa9.png[/img]
[h2]Equipment upgrades[/h2]

While exploring the town of Single Valley, you may notice strange individuals (who suspiciously look like yourself) stuck in some of the most hard-to-reach places. Those are [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/7e177ce5d8edaf42d253fc61baca834964ea0565.png[/img][b]clones[/b]. By rescuing them, you obtain [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/d5075552181ff9127c907555900f9eb24151ef1c.png[/img][b]duct tape[/b]: a valuable currency.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CURMamh.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/d5075552181ff9127c907555900f9eb24151ef1c.png[/img][b]Duct tape[/b] is used to upgrade your equipment:

[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/699f824e8a5461610640061f1f291da39e2c95f9.png[/img][h3]Trainers[/h3]- movement speed, swim speed, dodge length[/quote][quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/e03642743fa587e04093ef54fc749e3330c4b62e.png[/img][h3]Bag[/h3]- inventory capacity[/quote][quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/15b6950863daa3e888ae23572d3ab207ac179432.png[/img][h3]Trash Can Lid[/h3]- trash can lid (shield) capacity[/quote][quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/4751dae17e68b4c29c382cb5429f667fe0daa2da.png[/img][h3]Slingshot[/h3]- range, stun, knockback ability[/quote]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RC1B84U.gif[/img]


Alternatively you can use duct tape as currency to buy items from this…strange individual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/8a02aa8b18374f94b821176e07eca881d904026f.png[/img]


Oh, about those clones. They really like to appear in all sorts of tricky places. So it's not goint to be easy to rescue all of them.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vIwTzUS.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/bb4ab07b01dfb3bec8528bf057fb8ebaf73ff122.png[/img]
[h2]Collectibles[/h2]

Speaking about tricky places: your desire for exploration will be rewarded by discovering hidden collectible items on your journey.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1o6Uxxu.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/5670e123dc1ccfa56affc030f8bf5c11d11dbd59.png[/img]

notes.title: 2 days before release! | New mechanics breakdown
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, dear residents![/h1]

We're super excited for the release of [b][i]Mayhem in Single Valley[/i][/b], which is going to be out this Thursday. Until then, we decided to tell you more about the most recent gameplay mechanics that we've added to the game.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/d61c7c025fec61dc51895cf40fdebac7b57b4ebb.png[/img][h2]Hooch-covered items[/h2]

Those who've played the demo may remember that each enemy in the game, be it a small squirrel or a giant rhino, can be distracted with different items—mainly food or fruits. Each animal has its favorite delicacy:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/f25ed1008a4c469a458a29f0a5e45fadee53261c.gif[/img]

However, thes baits have just a temporary effect. After devouring an apple, the rhino will continue chasing you in an attempt to knock you out of your shoes. So what would be the solution to that? Cure the poor thing, of course! Enter [b]hooch[/b], the ultimate panacea that is going to save Single Valley.

You can gather hooch at dispensers that can be found in the world. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/773ffdd76f88f19f73250d28f5ea4e11b66740aa.png[/img]

You can store hooch in empty jars. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/02d16c179c481166c7bae58c63a54ea97ecddc6f.png[/img] Keep an eye out for them. Usually they can be collected near the hooch dispensers. Once you've filled a jar with hooch [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/59819d765cbaa88e9a1ed9676abd93c286cf2105.png[/img], combine it with any throwable item you have in your inventory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/30ebffcca052c4e2b627e04ee094867d0c7188d7.png[/img]+[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/59819d765cbaa88e9a1ed9676abd93c286cf2105.png[/img]=[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/91579050ff14fcc6ed043aeafee66ccae13c9650.png[/img]

Hooch-covered items are powerful…um, weapons? Not really, but they do the trick, which is letting you survive for just a little longer. Using a proper hooch-covered snack to lure away an animal or a human will [b]permanently cure them[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SkJFwko.gif[/img]

Swarmed by crazed irradiated creatures? Create an ultimate item—[b]hooch-covered dynamite[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34780277/e5a9d776aeeca3b186e3f8e3c35d13e06f05d5c7.png[/img]! Upon exploding, it cures all creatures in its range. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fmdfqAD.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update: Enhanced visuals, gameplay & UI changes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, dear residents of Single Valley![/b][/h3]

City management continues to work hard in an effort to better our town. This time they've made some quality-of-life improvements to Single Valley and addressed a lot of pressing issues!

Below is the full list of changes.


[h3][b]- ART & ANIMATIONS -[/b][/h3]

• [b]The demo has been moved to [u]the newer version on the Unity engine[/u] and now looks much prettier, with new reflections and various beautiful effects![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605183/eaa09b852826077cbe9b905a3c28767ebfc21576.jpg[/img]

• Stunned and alerted animations added

[h3][b]- GAMEPLAY -[/b][/h3]

• Doors remain open unless you close them, zombies can enter if you don't close them and you were previously being chased
• Chipmunks, frogs and armadillos added (cool, isn't it?)
• Mouse controls added for throwing and cycling through important inventory items: 
[olist][*] Mouse left click on screen: shoot in any direction, 
[*] Roll mouse wheel: quick select ammo
[*] Click down mouse wheel: quick select utility (sling shot etc.)
[*] Mouse right click: drop an item
[/olist]
• Stun animations added to most NPCs
• Large animals like gorilla cannot be stunned and a dull sound on the blue impact circle indicates this
• Rhino has a new short-range attack
• [b]Zoo[/b] level exits made more obvious
• Interact shine added to all zoo cage switches
• Sped up load times between levels
• Changed iris wipe between levels to a more subtle fade in/out
• Mouse click support added for all UI and in-game menus
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605183/4a0c2c775d52a005754c2b55814e173b4a5e1b1f.gif[/img]

• Most NPCs will now investigate sounds if you throw an item and the NPC has not seen you yet

[h3][b]- BUG FIXES / IMPROVEMENTS -[/b][/h3]

• Main hero Jack dragging equipment layers bug fixed
• Numerous controller mapping fixes
• Language selection getting stuck bug fixed
• The cassette player buttons are now more responsive
• Collectibles not showing up in the inventory until the second time you open it fixed
• Two emissive sections of sprites fixed

[h3][b]- UI -[/b][/h3]

• Animated icons are now shown whenever you pick up an item
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37605183/3bf74dd072cb890e59e19224cc0466133dbac425.gif[/img]

• UI for ammo in center middle of the screen, with equipment and foot UI to either side
• Tips for push and drag now appear on screen just below the main hero
• Trash can lids appear on the top left of screen - like HP in a traditional retro game
• Controls overview added for mouse controls
• Custom mouse pointer and throw icon added
• Text and controls tips images now align correctly
• An icon added to show the order of the inventory pages
• The dedicated equipment inventory page added
• Mapping inputs were given more descriptive names
• Version number added to title screen to easily identify builds

[h3][b]- SOUND -[/b][/h3]

• Church bells, ambient & reverb sounds were added to the Graveyard
• New rhino sounds added

Join other residents on our official [url=https://discord.gg/mayheminsinglevalley]Discord server[/url]!

[b]Thank you to all the people visiting our cosy town — and especially those who are kind enough to help us improve Single Valley![/b]

[h3]Until next time![/h3]
